property_summary: Any call to C's fallback that succeeds must carry exactly 10 ether (the require guards every non-10-ether call), so for any fuzzed amount and timestamp, a low-level call with value != 10 ether must revert in the reference C; the mutant accepts it, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether) check so calls with any value are accepted.
